root_cause: The canonical Required gate still carried a large unconditional shared preflight suite. Lane routing removed duplicate domain jobs, but low-risk documentation/governance changes continued to pay much of the same preflight cost as production runtime changes.
prevention_rule: Classify every changed path into risk R0-R4 and affected capabilities before the heavy shared suite. R0/R1 may use the fast impact gate; R2-R4 and hot/unknown executable surfaces stay fail-closed on the full shared suite. Deploy-preview browser sweeps must apply bounded provider backpressure: lower default route/viewport concurrency and retry only explicit transient HTTP status classes; persistent responses remain failures.

evidence.first_protected_run: Adaptive planner classified the control-plane candidate as R2/hot and selected the full shared suite as designed.
evidence.preview_backpressure_incident: The exact Netlify deploy preview returned bursts of HTTP 403 during a 4-route x 3-viewport visibility crawl while targeted route checks on the same preview were HTTP 200. The crawler now reduces preview concurrency and retries only bounded transient HTTP classes before failing closed.
